check_size.raw: Founder grant S$20,000–S$50,000; Tech POC up to S$250,000, POV up to S$500,000

strategy.thesis: National umbrella brand administered by Enterprise Singapore that unifies government support schemes for startups: Founder grants, equity co-investment, deep-tech proof-of-concept funding, accelerator support, talent and loans.

program.eligibility: Singapore-registered startups; Startup SG Founder requires first-time entrepreneurs applying through an Accredited Mentor Partner.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to individual schemes via Enterprise Singapore; Startup SG Founder applications go through Accredited Mentor Partners (AMPs).

summary.en: Startup SG is Singapore's national umbrella programme, administered by Enterprise Singapore, bundling support schemes including Startup SG Founder (S$20K–S$50K matched grants for first-time founders), Startup SG Tech (POC up to S$250K, POV up to S$500K), Startup SG Equity (government co-investment), Accelerator, Talent and Loan.

sources.supports: Administered by Enterprise Singapore; sub-schemes Founder, Tech, Equity, Accelerator, Talent, Loan
sources.quote: Startup SG Equity ... Co-invest with independent, qualified third party investors into eligible startups

strategy.thesis: Government-owned deep-tech investing and venture-building platform that co-invests in research-driven, science-based startups spun out of Singapore's universities and research institutes.

application.how_to_apply: Engage via SGInnovate's deep-tech programmes and co-investment as a Startup SG Equity fund manager.

summary.en: SGInnovate is a government-owned innovation platform established in 2016 to develop and scale deep-tech startups from Singapore. It manages a roughly S$200 million portion of the Startup SG Equity fund and co-invests in research-driven technology companies.

sources.title: SGInnovate - Wikipedia
sources.supports: Founded 2016, government-owned, deep tech, manages $200M of Startup SG Equity
sources.quote: SGInnovate is a government-owned innovation platform in Singapore centred on the development of deep technology. It was established in 2016 ... SGInnovate manages a portion of the Startup SG Equity fund worth $200 million.

verification_notes: Government-owned (Government of Singapore). Specific check sizes not disclosed publicly.

current_fund.raw: S$150M over three years (to catalyse ~S$300M with partners)

strategy.thesis: The investment arm of Enterprise Singapore; co-invests alongside qualified private VC partners under Startup SG Equity into Singapore-based deep-tech startups with global potential.

application.how_to_apply: Startups raise from one of SEEDS Capital's appointed co-investment partners, who can then trigger matched government co-investment.

summary.en: SEEDS Capital is Enterprise Singapore's investment arm, co-investing with private VC partners under the Startup SG Equity scheme into Singapore-based deep-tech startups. It set aside S$150M over three years to catalyse a further ~S$300M and has 100+ deep-tech startups in its portfolio. In 2025 it merged with EDBI to form SG Growth Capital.

sources.title: SEEDS Capital

strategy.thesis: The corporate investment arm of Singapore's Economic Development Board; invests in high-growth global technology and healthcare companies and runs a fund-of-funds model, helping firms scale in and anchor to Singapore.

application.how_to_apply: Direct outreach to EDBI investment teams; selective late-stage and growth investing.

summary.en: EDBI, established in 1991, is the corporate investment arm of Singapore's Economic Development Board. It invests in high-growth global technology and healthcare companies (direct and via fund-of-funds) and is an appointed fund manager under Startup SG Equity. In 2025 it merged with SEEDS Capital to form SG Growth Capital.

sources.title: About EDBI

sources.quote: EDBI, established in 1991, is the corporate investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB).

sources.quote: Formation of SG Growth Capital to bolster Singapore's efforts in building innovative enterprises

strategy.thesis: Malaysia's early-stage startup funding agency, providing grants and conditional/equity investment to high-calibre tech startups through programmes such as CIP Spark, CIP Sprint and DEQ800.

investment.raw: CIP Spark and CIP Sprint grants; amounts vary by programme

application.how_to_apply: Apply to specific Cradle programmes (CIP Spark, CIP Sprint, etc.) via the Cradle website.

summary.en: Cradle Fund Sdn Bhd is Malaysia's early-stage startup funding agency, established in 2003. It funds high-calibre technology startups through its Cradle Investment Programme and related grants, and has supported over 1,000 Malaysian technology-based companies. Cradle also powers the national MYStartup platform.

sources.title: Cradle Fund
sources.supports: Established 2003; over 1000 companies supported; HQ Kuala Lumpur; programmes
sources.quote: Cradle has supported over 1000 Malaysian Technology-Based companies across multiple sectors

verification_notes: Originally incorporated under the Ministry of Finance (2003); now operates as the focal-point agency under the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI). Specific grant amounts vary by programme and were not consistently disclosed; set null.

strategy.thesis: Malaysia's national fund-of-funds under Khazanah's Dana Impak, investing into VC fund managers (not directly into startups) to deepen the domestic venture capital ecosystem via the Emerging Fund Managers' Programme and Regional Managers' Initiative.

people.name: Bryan Lim
people.role: Chief Executive Officer (also Khazanah Head of Dana Impak)

application.how_to_apply: VC fund managers apply to the Emerging Fund Managers' Programme (EMP) or Regional Managers' Initiative (RMI).

summary.en: Jelawang Capital is Malaysia's national fund-of-funds, launched in 2024 by Khazanah Nasional after consolidating MAVCAP and Penjana Kapital. With an initial RM1 billion allocation under Khazanah's Dana Impak, it invests into VC fund managers via the Emerging Fund Managers' Programme and Regional Managers' Initiative to accelerate Malaysia's venture capital ecosystem.

sources.title: Khazanah launches Jelawang Capital as national fund-of-funds

strategy.thesis: National startup ecosystem platform initiated by MOSTI and powered by Cradle Fund; centralises funding directories and runs accelerator, pre-accelerator, bootcamp and hackathon programmes.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to MYStartup Accelerator, Pre-Accelerator, Bootcamp or VentureX via the platform.

summary.en: MYStartup is Malaysia's national startup ecosystem platform, an initiative of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI) powered by Cradle Fund. It centralises a directory of national funding agencies and runs programmes including MYStartup Accelerator, Pre-Accelerator, Bootcamp, VentureX and MYHackathon.

sources.quote: An Initiative By ... Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI) ... Powered By ... Cradle Fund

strategy.thesis: Government mentoring and incubation movement (no direct funding) to nurture thousands of new Indonesian digital startups across priority sectors such as agriculture, marine, health, education, tourism and logistics.

application.how_to_apply: Register for the program cohorts via 1000startupdigital.id.

summary.en: Gerakan Nasional 1000 Startup Digital is an early-stage mentoring and incubation programme launched in 2016 by Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Information (Kominfo). It does not provide funding; instead it facilitates networking, team formation and mentoring across six priority sectors.
summary.local: Gerakan Nasional 1000 Startup Digital adalah program pendampingan startup tahap awal yang diinisiasi Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika sejak 2016; program ini tidak memberikan dukungan dalam bentuk pendanaan.

sources.quote: Gerakan Nasional 1000 Startup Digital tidak memberikan dukungan dalam bentuk pendanaan.

verification_notes: Mentoring/incubation program with no capital deployment; included as a public-sector startup program per segment scope.

strategy.thesis: Public-sector pre-startup and startup capacity-building program run by Indonesia's tourism and creative economy authority (Kemenparekraf/Baparekraf), equipping founders with skills and knowledge to reduce failure risk.

program.eligibility: Indonesian prospective and early-stage startup founders.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to BEKUP program cohorts via the Baparekraf for Startup site.

summary.en: Baparekraf for Startup (BEKUP), originally BEKRAF for Pre-Startup, is an Indonesian government capacity-building program (launched 2016) run by the Ministry of Tourism and Creative Economy / Baparekraf. It equips prospective and early-stage founders with the skills and knowledge to build startups, minimising the risk of failure.
summary.local: Baparekraf for Startup (BEKUP) bertujuan meningkatkan jumlah startup berkualitas di Indonesia melalui program yang membekali calon pendiri startup dengan keterampilan dan pengetahuan.

verification_notes: Originated as BEKRAF for Pre-Startup (2016) under the now-merged Creative Economy Agency (BEKRAF); now run by Kemenparekraf/Baparekraf. Capacity-building/incubation, not a funding vehicle.

strategy.thesis: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, co-investing with global partners primarily in infrastructure, energy, logistics and select strategic sectors; largely late-stage/mature companies rather than early-stage startups.

application.how_to_apply: Institutional co-investment partnerships; not a startup application program.

summary.en: The Indonesia Investment Authority (INA) is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, launched in February 2021 with a target to manage US$24.5 billion. It co-invests with global partners mainly in infrastructure, energy and logistics; its only notable tech exposure is a US$300M late-stage investment in Traveloka, so it is only tangentially a startup-funding body.

verification_notes: Included because segment scope mentions national/sovereign funds, but INA is predominantly an infrastructure/late-stage co-investor, not a startup-focused fund. May be integrated into Danantara, Indonesia's larger 2025 sovereign fund, over time.

strategy.thesis: Thailand's national innovation agency under MHESI, supporting startups and innovators via a 'Groom-Grant-Growth-Global' strategy with grants, thematic innovation funding and a corporate co-funding (equity) scheme.

investment.raw: Thematic Innovation grants up to ฿5M; over ฿200M total (2022)

program.eligibility: Thai-owned (51%+) startups/companies with their own technology or innovation; typically 3+ years industry experience for thematic grants.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to NIA grant/co-funding schemes (e.g. Thematic Innovation, corporate co-funding) via nia.or.th.

summary.en: The National Innovation Agency (NIA) is Thailand's public agency under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (MHESI), established in 2003. It supports startups via a 'Groom-Grant-Growth-Global' strategy, offering thematic innovation grants (over ฿200M in 2022, up to ฿5M per business) and a corporate co-funding scheme investing up to ฿10M at seed to pre-Series A. It also runs the Startup Thailand brand.

sources.supports: Over ฿200M grants in 2022; up to ฿5M per business via Thematic Innovation; 51% Thai ownership
sources.quote: Thailand's National Innovation Agency (NIA) offered over 200 million baht to startups in 2022 through the "Thematic Innovation" programme ... Up to 5 million baht available per business

verification_notes: Established by Cabinet resolution 2003; constituted as a Public Organization in 2009, now under MHESI. Grant figures are program/year specific.

name.en: Technology and Innovation-Based Enterprise Development Fund (TED Fund)

summary.en: TED Fund is Thailand's Technology and Innovation-Based Enterprise Development Fund under MHESI. It provides grants to tech/innovation entrepreneurs and startups, including TED Youth Startup (฿100,000–฿1,500,000 for students/graduates), Market Scaling Up and Startups-for-Startups (up to ฿2,000,000 per project), with annual support targets around ฿200–220M.

summary.en: The Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa) is a Thai government agency that promotes the country's digital economy. It manages a startup fund, runs digital innovation institutes, the Smart City initiative and co-investment/voucher mechanisms aimed at developing Thai digital startups.

sources.title: Thailand's Digital Departments and Agencies
sources.supports: depa manages a startup fund, IoT/digital institute, co-working, Smart City
sources.quote: DEPA manages a startup fund, runs an IoT & Digital Innovation Institute ... including overseeing the Smart City initiative.

verification_notes: depa was established under the Digital Development for Economy and Society Act B.E. 2560 (2017). Specific co-investment amounts not consistently disclosed; set null.

name.local: Trung tâm Hỗ trợ khởi nghiệp sáng tạo Quốc gia

strategy.thesis: Vietnam's leading public hub for innovation and entrepreneurship under the Ministry of Science and Technology; implements Project 844 (the national startup support scheme) and runs the flagship Techfest Vietnam to support early- and growth-stage startups.

program.eligibility: Vietnamese innovative startups and ecosystem builders.

application.how_to_apply: Engage via Techfest Vietnam and NSSC/Project 844 support programs.

summary.en: The National Startup Support Center (NSSC) is Vietnam's leading public hub for innovation and entrepreneurship, established by the Ministry of Science and Technology. It implements Project 844 (the national startup support scheme, established by Decision 844/QD-TTg in 2016) and runs the flagship Techfest Vietnam, supporting startups across deeptech, greentech, agritech, healthtech and digital transformation.
summary.local: Trung tâm Hỗ trợ khởi nghiệp sáng tạo Quốc gia (NSSC) là đầu mối công lập hàng đầu của Việt Nam hỗ trợ đổi mới sáng tạo và khởi nghiệp, trực thuộc Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ.

application.how_to_apply: Engage via Project 844 and NATEC programs under the Ministry of Science and Technology.

summary.en: NATEC is Vietnam's National Agency for Technology Entrepreneurship and Commercialization Development, under the Ministry of Science and Technology. It co-leads the national innovative startup ecosystem through Project 844, supports technology commercialization and builds international startup connections (e.g. Silicon Valley, Startup World Cup).

strategy.thesis: Government venture capital fund established under the Innovative Startup Act, deployed by DTI and the National Development Company to co-invest in innovative Philippine startups from Seed to Series B.

application.how_to_apply: Co-investment through DTI/NDC and QBO Innovation Hub processes.

summary.en: The Startup Venture Fund (SVF) is a Philippine government venture capital fund created under the Innovative Startup Act (R.A. 11337) and launched in November 2021 by the Department of Trade and Industry and the National Development Company, with QBO Innovation Hub. The NDC allocated PHP 250 million (~US$5M) to co-invest in innovative startups from Seed to Series B.

sources.supports: PHP 250M fund launched by DTI and NDC; Seed to Series B
sources.quote: The NDC allocated PHP 250 million (US$5M) venture fund for innovative Philippine startups in the Seed to Series B stage.

strategy.thesis: The Philippines' first public-private partnership startup innovation hub, providing incubation, mentorship, programs, coworking and access to investors for Filipino startups.

program.eligibility: Filipino and foreign startup founders in the Philippines.

Morgan, the Department of Science and Technology (DOST) and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI). It provides incubation, mentorship, programs, coworking and investor access, and reports supporting 700+ startups.

strategy.thesis: Brunei statutory government agency enabling growth of MSMEs and startups via bootcamp accelerators, the iCentre incubator/co-working space, financing schemes and business academies.

summary.en: Darussalam Enterprise (DARe) is a Brunei government agency established in 2016 to grow MSMEs and startups. It runs a ~100-day Startup Bootcamp accelerator and Micro Business Bootcamp (six cycles a year), the iCentre incubator/co-working space, financing schemes and the Industry Business Academy. DARe bears program costs and takes no equity; its first three Accelerate cycles saw startups raise hundreds of thousands of BND.

sources.title: DARe CEO: Aspiring entrepreneurs invited to join business bootcamps

sources.quote: Startup Bootcamp: 100-day accelerator equipping startups with tools and connections to scale rapidly ... Cycle 1 (2016): 21 companies raised $411,000

verification_notes: DARe established 2016 under Brunei government. Program length ~100 days (set ~14 weeks). Equity-free; investment figures are startup-raised amounts per cycle, not DARe capital.

strategy.thesis: Implementation unit of Cambodia's Entrepreneurship Development Fund under the Ministry of Economy and Finance; provides financial grants and non-financial support to startups, SMEs and ecosystem builders.

program.eligibility: Cambodian startups and SMEs in priority sectors (tech, services, agro-processing, manufacturing for import substitution).

application.how_to_apply: Apply to Khmer Enterprise grant/assistance packages via Startup Cambodia.

summary.en: Khmer Enterprise (Entrepreneurship Promotion Center) is the implementation unit of Cambodia's Entrepreneurship Development Fund, established in early 2019 under the Ministry of Economy and Finance. It provides financial grants (typically US$5,000–US$20,000 per recipient) and non-financial support to startups, SMEs and ecosystem builders, and co-coordinates the national Startup Cambodia program.
